text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
AUSTRALIA, June 30 - COAL - QUEENSLAND - Abbot Point - Berth vacant, 5 vessels due by 25/7, no delays.
Hay Point - Maintenance shutdown on berth No.2 from 10/6 to 8/7. One vessel loading, 4 waiting, 9 due by 12/7, no delays.
Dalrymple Bay - Two vessels loading, 20 due by 26/7, no delays.
Gladstone - Curragh now in its seventh week of strike, no affect on shipping at present as still drawing from stockpile/blending. Gordonstone returned to work 21/6.

R.G. Tanna - 27 Vessels due by 27/7, no delays. barney point - 1 vessel loading, 2 due by 5/7, no delays. brisbane - one vessel loading, 3 vessels due by 27/7, no delays. new south wales - newcastle - hunter valley no. 1 now in third week of strike. there is no conclusion indicated. shipping is not affected at the moment as still drawing from stockpiles.
Kooragang - 2 Vessels loading, 13 waiting, 21 due by 12/7, 11 days delay.
Dyke 4+5 - 2 Vessels loading, 13 waiting, 21 due by 21/7, 7-8 days delay.
Port Kembla - One vessel loading, 2 waiting, 25 due by 8/8, no delays.

IRON ORE - WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Port Kembla - Mt. Newman (Nelson Point) - Iron ore vessels may experience some berthing delays/loading delays or be forced to berth out of turn. A train derailment which occurred 25/6 caused substantial track damage and carting was subsequently affected. Shippers advise that track is now in order and carting recommenced 28/6. Berth A - Five vessels anchored. Berth B - 1 Vessel loading, 4 anchored, 6 due by 8/7. 5 Other vessels due with no eta.
Goldsworthy - Finucane Island - 1 Vessel loading, 2 due by 7/7, 3 others due.
Dampier - Parker Point - 1 Vessel loading, 6 anchored.
E.I. Island - 1 Vessel loading, 5 anchored.
Dampier lineup - 1 Vessel anchored, 25 due by 19/7.
Port Walcott - One vessel loading, 1 berthed, 4 anchored, 14 due by 23/7.
July 2 - GRAIN - QUEENSLAND - Mackay, Gladstone - No vessels due.
Brisbane - One vessel loading wheat, 1 wheat vessel due.
NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - One wheat vessel in port, 1 wheat vessel due 4/7.
Port Kembla - Three vessels in port, 3 wheat vessels due by 9/7.
VICTORIA - Geelong - Three vessels due by 22/7.
Portland - Three vessels due by 13/7. The terminal will be closed July 10 due to meeting.
SOUTH AUSTRALIA - Port Pirie, Thevenard, Wallaroo, Ardrsan, Port Giles - No vessels due.
Port Adelaide - One wheat vessel in port.
Port Lincoln - One vessel loading wheat.
WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Geraldton - Three vessels due by 10/7.
Kwinana - Six vessels due by 18/7.
Albany - Three vessels due by 17/7.
Esperance - One vessel loading canola, 1 barley vessel due on 24/7.
